title: Delta-encoded supersedes chain contract (L13)
description: Invariants for delta-encoded supersedes-update semantics on compact-card-v1 cards. See ADR-025.

added_fields.name: delta_removed_keys
added_fields.description: summary keys explicitly deleted in this update; empty list if none

invariants.name: delta_mode_enum_only
invariants.description: Cards declare delta_mode in {full, partial, tombstone}. No other values allowed.
must: validator rejects delta_mode outside the enum
delta_mode_enum is read from this contract file, not hardcoded in Python

invariants.name: first_card_is_full
invariants.description: The first card of any chain (supersedes_card_id=null) MUST be delta_mode=full.
must: writer validates: supersedes_card_id is null implies delta_mode=full
consumer rejects chain start that is not full

invariants.name: partial_requires_supersedes
invariants.description: A card with delta_mode=partial MUST have supersedes_card_id != null.
must: validator rejects partial card whose supersedes_card_id is null

invariants.name: chain_depth_bound
invariants.description: Replay walks chain backward to find a full card. Depth > chain_max_depth -> fail-closed to raw replay.
must: walker counts hops; exceeding depth raises ChainDepthExceeded and triggers raw replay fallback
fallback path logs WARNING with chain start card_id and exceeded depth

invariants.name: tombstone_terminates
invariants.description: No card may declare supersedes_card_id pointing to a card whose delta_mode=tombstone. Once tombstoned, a new chain starts fresh.
must: writer rejects supersedes_card_id pointing at a tombstone card
reader treats tombstone as 'subject retired'; reading after returns None

invariants.name: per_card_hash
invariants.description: card_hash is computed over the card's OWN content (delta-encoded summary). Verification is per-card; no need to reconstruct the full record to verify.
must: writer computes card_hash over the partial summary as-stored
verifier checks card_hash without reconstructing the chain
matches ADR-024 CDC-003 deterministic hash semantics

invariants.name: delta_removed_keys_required
invariants.description: delta_removed_keys is required on every card (may be empty list). Reconstruction skips listed keys when walking the chain.
must: every card has delta_removed_keys field (empty list permitted)
reconstruction walker treats listed keys as 'deleted in this generation' and does NOT inherit them from upstream cards
absence of the field is a validator error

out_of_scope: L1 prefetch policy preferring 'full' cards (separate ADR)
Tombstone-driven retraining of derived indices (separate ADR)
Garbage collection of fully-superseded chains (separate ADR)
